tools.name: palim_resume
tools.description: Continue the user's most recent Palim thread. Call first in a new chat, no args. Ignore the result if it is unrelated. Project filter is case-insensitive and returns the most recently updated match.

tools.name: palim_checkpoint
tools.description: Call after connecting AND again after each meaningful chunk of work. Claude Code: reuse claude-code-<client session id>.

tools.name: palim_save_context
tools.description: Lightweight checkpoint: self-contained handoff, no transcript. Reuse session_id in this chat. Proactive after results and decisions, not only once.

tools.name: palim_save_session
tools.description: Save or append a full chat transcript (messages + summary). Exclude children's personal data under 16/higher consent age, HIPAA PHI, PCI payment card data, and adult content; request redaction before saving. Prefer palim_save_context for compact handoffs. For metadata-only or URL updates use palim_u

tools.name: palim_get_context
tools.description: Get formatted context for a specific topic by searching and retrieving relevant sessions.

tools.name: palim_get_brain
tools.description: Distilled knowledge profile. No args: recent topic index (capped). With topic: full document. Pass limit for a larger or full index.

tools.name: palim_search
tools.description: Search saved sessions and memories. Query matches session text or memory content/id. Supports metadata filtering via tags/project/status/tool_source. Omit query for tags-only or project-only session filtering. Project match is case-insensitive.

tools.name: palim_add_memory
tools.description: Store a memory, fact, decision, or preference for later retrieval.

tools.name: palim_delete_memory
tools.description: Permanently delete one stored memory by ID. Use for user-requested cleanup or deletion; this cannot be undone.

tools.name: palim_delete_session
tools.description: Delete a chat session. Soft delete by default (reversible). Use hard_delete=true for permanent deletion.

tools.name: palim_help
tools.description: Show an overview of all available Palim tools and usage instructions.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "palim_save_session" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Save or append a full chat transcript (messages + summary). Exclude children's personal data under 16/higher consent age, HIPAA PHI, PCI payment card data, and …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: palim_save_session · Private data: palim_get_brain · Public sink: palim_save_session · Destructive: palim_delete_memory, palim_delete_session.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: palim_save_session · Private data: palim_get_brain · Public sink: palim_save_session · Destructive: palim_delete_memory, palim_delete_session

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
